results.question: How does the network notify UEs about a change to MCCH information?
results.reference: it notifies the UEs about the change via PDCCH which schedules the MCCH in every repetition period in the current modification period
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.1.3, MCCH information validity and notification of changes
results.model_answer:
According to [5] Clause 5.9.1.3 — MCCH information validity and notification of changes:

"When the network changes (some of) the MCCH information, it notifies the UEs about the change via PDCCH which schedules the MCCH in every repetition period in the current modification period."

The notification is transmitted with a 2-bit bitmap, see TS 38.212 clause 7.3.1.2.1. 

The MSB in the 2-bit bitmap, when set to '1', indicates the start of MBS service(s). 
The LSB in the 2-bit bitmap, when set to '1', indicates modification of MCCH information other than the change caused by start of new MBS service(s), e.g. modification of a configuration of an on-going MBS session(s), MBS session(s) stop or neighbouring cell information modification.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE trigger the lower layer to initiate the Random Access procedure on supplementary uplink for on-demand SI?
results.reference: if SIB1 includes si-SchedulingInfo containing si-RequestConfigSUL and criteria to select supplementary uplink as defined in TS 38.321, clause 5.1.1 is met
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.3, Request for on demand system information
results.model_answer:
Here is the answer:

**Clause 5.2.2.3.3 — Request for on demand system information**

The UE shall, while T319a is not running:

1 > if SIB1 includes si-SchedulingInfo containing si-RequestConfigSUL and **criteria to select supplementary uplink as defined in TS 38.321, clause 5.1.1 is met**:
2 > trigger the lower layer to initiate the Random Access procedure on supplementary uplink in accordance with message(s) that the UE requires to operate within the cell, and for which si-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting; 

Similarly, for on-demand positioning system information:

**Clause 5.2.2.3.3a — Request for on demand positioning system information**

The UE shall, while T319a is not running:

1 > if SIB1 includes posSI-SchedulingInfo containing posSI-RequestConfigSUL and **criteria to select supplementary uplink as defined in TS 38.321, clause 5.1.1 is met**:

results.question: Which 3GPP technical specification clause contains the definition for Event B1?
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.8, Event B1 (Inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold)
results.model_answer:
Clause 5.5.4.8 — Event B1 (Inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold) 

Event B1 (Inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold)

The UE shall: 1 > consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled; 1 > consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition B1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled. Mn + Ofn + Ocn Hys > Thresh Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Thresh The variables in the formula are defined as follows: Mn is the measurement result of the inter-RAT neighbour cell, not taking into account any offsets. Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the frequency of the inter-RAT neighbour cell (i.e. eutra-Q- OffsetRange as defined within the measObjectEUTRA corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour inter- RAT cell, utra-FDD-Q-OffsetRange as defined within the measObjectUTRA-FDD corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour inter-RAT cell). Ocn is the cell specific offset of the inter-RAT neighbour cell (i.e. cellIndividualOffset as defined within the measObjectEUTRA corresponding to the neighbour inter-RAT cell), and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell. Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigInterRAT for this event). Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. b1-ThresholdEUTRA as defined within reportConfigInterRAT for this event, b1-ThresholdUTRA-FDD as defined for UTRA-FDD within reportConfigInterRAT for this event). Mn is expressed in dBm or in dB, depending on the measurement quantity of the inter-RAT neighbour cell. Ofn, Ocn, Hys are expressed in dB. Thresh is expressed in the same unit as Mn.
results.evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.8, Event B1 (Inter RAT neighbour becomes better than threshold)

results.question: What does Event I1 trigger based on?
results.reference: Interference becomes higher than threshold
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.10, Event I1 (Interference becomes higher than threshold)

According to clause 5.5.4.10:

Event I1 (Interference becomes higher than threshold)

The UE shall: 
1 > consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition I1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled;
1 > consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition I1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled.

 Mi > Thresh + Hys 
 Mi < Thresh - Hys 

The variables in the formula are defined as follows: 
Mi is the measurement result of the interference, not taking into account any offsets.
Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. i1-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
Mi, Thresh are expressed in dBm. 
Hys is expressed in dB.

Event I1 triggers based on interference measurement results (`Mi`) becoming higher than a threshold (`Thresh`).

results.question: What is the condition for the neighbour cell's RSRP to trigger Event A3?
results.reference: becomes offset better than the SpCell
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.4, Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)
results.model_answer:
According to Clause 5.5.4.4 — Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell):

The entering condition for this event is satisfied when:
`Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off`

The leaving condition for this event is satisfied when:
`Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off`

Where:
- `Mn` is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets.
- `Ofn` is the measurement object specific offset of the reference signal of the neighbour cell.
- `Ocn` is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell, and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell.
- `Hys` is the hysteresis parameter for this event.
- `Mp` is the measurement result of the SpCell, not taking into account any offsets.
- `Ofp` is the measurement object specific offset of the SpCell.
- `Ocp` is the cell specific offset of the SpCell, and is set to zero if not configured for the SpCell.
- `Off` is the offset parameter for this event.

Note that for RSRP, `Mn` and `Mp` are expressed in dBm.
results.evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.4, Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)

results.question: Under what intra-RAT condition while T331 is running does the UE stop T331 and perform actions in 5.7.8.3?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.4, Cell re-selection or cell selection while T331 is running

The UE shall:
1 > if intra-RAT cell selection or reselection occurs while T331 is running:

    3 > if the serving frequency does not match with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList; or
    3 > if the serving frequency matches with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList, the validityCellList is included in that entry, and the physical cell identity of the serving cell does not match with any entry in validityCellList:
  4 > stop timer T331;
  4 > perform the actions as specified in 5.7.8.3, upon which the procedure ends.

So, the intra-RAT condition is:
- if the serving frequency does not match with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList; or
- if the serving frequency matches with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList, the validityCellList is included in that entry, and the physical cell identity of the serving cell does not match with any entry in validityCellList.

results.question: What is the purpose of the FailureInformation message?
results.reference: used to indicate a failure in the RRC connection reconfiguration procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.5, Failure information
results.model_answer:
The purpose of the FailureInformation message is to inform the network about a failure, which can be:

* RLC failure information
* DAPS failure information
* Sidelink radio link failure or sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure (as mentioned in clause 5.8.3.1)

More specifically, as mentioned in clause 5.7.5.3:

* to provide RLC failure information, including:
	+ logicalChannelIdentity of the failing RLC bearer
	+ cellGroupId of the failing RLC bearer
	+ failureType as rlc-failure
* to provide DAPS failure information, including:
	+ failureType as daps-failure

The FailureInformation message is used to inform the network about a failure for an:
* MCG RLC bearer 
* SCG RLC bearer 
* DAPS failure information 

It is submitted to lower layers for transmission via SRB1 or SRB3, depending on the type of failure and the UE's configuration (e.g., (NG)EN-DC or NR-DC). 

In MR-DC, it can be embedded in ULInformationTransferMRDC message as specified in clause 5.7.2a.3.

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.3, Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
results.model_answer:
According to [5] Clause 5.4.3.3 — Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE:

1 > if the targetRAT-Type is set to eutra:
2 > consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards E-UTRA;
2 > **forward the nas-SecurityParamFromNR to the upper layers, if included**; 

Additionally, according to [6] Clause 5.4.3.4 — Successful completion of the mobility from NR:

1 > if the targetRAT-Type is set to eutra and the nas-SecurityParamFromNR is included:
... 

So the UE shall **forward the nas-SecurityParamFromNR to the upper layers, if included**.
results.evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 3, > start or restart timer T342 with the timer value set to the delayBudgetReportingProhibitTimer;

results.question: From which entity is NAS dedicated information transferred in the General ULInformationTransfer procedure?
results.reference: from the UE
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer
results.model_answer:
A UE in RRC_CONNECTED or a UE in RRC_INACTIVE during SDT initiates the UL information transfer procedure whenever there is a need to transfer **NAS dedicated information**. 

So, the NAS dedicated information is transferred from: 
**a UE in RRC_CONNECTED or a UE in RRC_INACTIVE during SDT**.
results.evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer

results.question: To which entity is F1-C related information transferred via IAB-MT in RRC CONNECTED?
results.reference: to IAB Donor-CU
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer
results.model_answer:
According to [6] Clause 5.7.1.1 — General DLInformationTransfer:

"...or to transfer F1-C related information from IAB Donor-CU to IAB-DU via IAB-MT in RRC_CONNECTED."

and 

[7] Clause 5.7.2.1 — General ULInformationTransfer:

"...or to transfer F1-C related information from IAB-DU to IAB Donor-CU via IAB-MT in RRC CONNECTED."

The F1-C related information is transferred from:
- IAB Donor-CU to IAB-DU 
- IAB-DU to IAB Donor-CU 

via IAB-MT in RRC CONNECTED.
results.evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.12.1, General IAB-MT Network IABOtherInformation
